questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Dartmouth offers a strong finance program with renowned faculty and rigorous coursework that complements studies at the University of Copenhagen. The exchange provides an opportunity to experience a different pedagogical approach and academic culture in a highly regarded American institution.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Dartmouth is a well-known institution with a strong academic reputation and excellent faculty. The exchange provided an opportunity to experience a different pedagogical approach and broaden my perspective in a new academic environment.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was easy to find the necessary information both before and during the exchange. The provided materials were clear, understandable, and easy to navigate throughout the process.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: A coordinator provided a comprehensive full-day orientation upon arrival, showing us around campus and covering the essential information about the stay.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: On-campus housing options included single rooms, doubles with one roommate, or larger accommodations with three other students. The on-campus housing is located at the center of Dartmouth College.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: A variety of options - there is a large dining hall with a lot of different options for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Other dining places are also available around campus.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Bring your own pillows, duvets, and sheets.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Write to individual professors and mention what coursework you have done as prerequisites for the courses you want to take at Dartmouth College. When a professor accepts your prerequisites you are registered for the course.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Basic descriptions of the courses on their course website.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very successful. As long as you have done some things that match the prerequisites.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Write an extensive mail to the professor describing why the course sounds interesting and what other coursework you have done that would help you succeed in that particular course.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of the courses i took were high. Expect to focus on the courses and join every class as the level increases during the semester. They have midterms, tests, presentations etc.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: In many classes, they expect students to join the engage and participate in discussions. All the professors i had were very dedicated to teaching students in a very understandable way.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International Finance, Theory of Finance and International Trade.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: International Trade with professor Robert Staiger. This courses teaches you international trade theory and incorporates some of the most well-known economists and is very relevant for real world international trade dynamics.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: You have to buy the meal plan as a first year student at Dartmouth meaning that exchange students have to enroll. I would recommend it as well.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Housing and food.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The outdoor nature is great in the fall and you can explore New Hampshire which is well-known for its mountains and ski places. The sports facilities are also great. Hiking is great in New Hampshire.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Many different activities are available to students, as they have a website for their different clubs where they invite students to hike, surfboard and do different sports like tennis, soccer and running.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend playing tennis with other Dartmouth College students. The tennis facilities are great, as they have both indoor and outdoor facilities.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go hike in New Hampshire, visit Vermont, and go to Boston.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy, as the US students are very outgoing and easy to talk with.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Do activities and join clubs with local students. I played soccer with local students which was a nice addition to the Dartmouth experience.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nothing really.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The openness and how engaged local students were in clubs, social events and in the class room.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: There is every sport you can think of so join a sport while you are at Dartmouth. Choose interesting courses, all the professors i had were great. Expect to do a lot of coursework.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: In autumn semester, it can go from very warm in September to very cold in November, so bring a variety of clothes.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The academic experience was the most rewarding. You are engaged in every class and you learn a lot from the courses.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The academic coursework was extensive and it demands a lot from you but if you attend every class and study it is rewarding.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
